description: One-call compound tool. Submit a concept, medium, audience, and constraints; receive a complete design package: historically grounded palette, cultural narrative, commercial paint matches, WCAG accessibility check, illuminant behaviour, and a ready-made image generation prompt. Replaces chaining query_conceptual + palette_from_concept + colour_story + match_paint_system + accessibility_check + get_colour_metrics. Use when an AI agent or user needs a complete, deployable colour direction in a single call. Not for iterative refinement; use individual tools for that. The result already carries the rendered palette and its PNG, PDF, ASE, JSON and CSS downloads, ready to show the customer. The archive anchors a colour was derived from are evidence, not the recommended colours. A final palette chosen from this evidence is registered with palette_finalize, called once with those exact colours, so the customer can see and download what was actually recommended.

avoid.description: Archive names or colour terms to exclude e.g. ['neon', 'ScreenDigital']

concept.description: Cultural theme, mood, or brief e.g. 'Victorian mourning', 'Ottoman court', 'Scandinavian minimal'

name: design_session

outputSchema.description: Structured JSON response. Shape varies by tool; most return an 'ok' boolean plus a 'result' or 'results' field with the tool's data payload.

title: Full Design Session: Concept to Complete Palette
